    u_idx = local_opt_tour

#{Adaptive Guided Local Search edge penalization dynamically scaling penalty strength by the tour edge coefficient of variation and soft-filtering high-utility edges via diameter-calibrated dynamic percentile thresholding.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    # Copy edge distance matrix to ensure purity and avoid in-place modification
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    
    # Extract consecutive edge endpoints along the local optimal tour
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    # Retrieve current edge lengths and their historical usage frequencies
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    # Calculate edge utilities balanced against prior penalizations
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    
    # Compute adaptive penalty coefficient lambda_k based on tour edge variance
    mean_len = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    std_len = np.std(tour_lengths)
    cov = std_len / (mean_len + 1e-12)
    lambda_k = mean_len * (0.1 + 0.5 * cov)
    
    # Approximate graph diameter proxy and determine dynamic threshold level
    graph_diameter_proxy = np.max(tour_lengths)
    scale_factor = mean_len / (graph_diameter_proxy + 1e-12)
    percentile_cutoff = np.clip(100.0 * (1.0 - 0.25 * scale_factor), 75.0, 99.0)
    
    # Filter candidate edges using dynamic thresholding to protect cycle structure
    threshold_val = np.percentile(utilities, percentile_cutoff)
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold_val
    
    # Ensure at least the maximal utility edge is penalized if none strictly exceed cutoff
    if not np.any(selected_mask):
        selected_mask[np.argmax(utilities)] = True
        
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    
    # Vectorized symmetric penalization of identified structural bottlenecks
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += lambda_k
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += lambda_k
    
    return updated_edge_distance
